paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 5.5 as of September 11, representing a 2.04% increase from the prior close and a 27.63% decrease over the past 22 sessions. There have been 3 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include discussions of the company's revenue and loss, as well as its plans to offer $350 million in convertible senior notes. The company's co-founder has also expressed confidence in a soon-to-be-announced tenant deal.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 form 4 filings, and 7 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include a form 8-K filing on August 31, which announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders, and form 4 filings on August 27 and August 18, which reported insider transactions.
